## Consolidated Findings

- product/docs/ux/prototype-registry.md: No formal accessibility audit or WCAG 2.1/2.2 compliance assessment exists for the pinned prototype (UXPROTO-CCEF-001). The prototype uses Material Symbols Outlined icons and a gradient background but has no documented color contrast analysis, keyboard navigation audit, or screen reader testing. This is a non-blocking gap for the current slice but should be addressed before demo planning.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-003.md: Language selection (UC-CCEF-003) has no prototype screen or visual design reference. The use case describes locale preference management but provides no interaction detail (dropdown vs radio group, auto-detection behavior, fallback language). This gap prevents UX-consistent implementation planning for this use case.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-007.md: Data subject rights (UC-CCEF-007) has no prototype screen or visual design reference. The use case describes access, rectification, erasure, and portability requests but provides no interaction detail (form fields, confirmation dialogs, status indicators). This gap prevents UX-consistent implementation planning for this use case.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-008.md: Data residency (UC-CCEF-008) has no prototype screen or visual design reference. The use case describes regional data storage preferences but provides no interaction detail (region selector, confirmation flow). This gap prevents UX-consistent implementation planning for this use case.
- product/requirements/FR-CCEF-003.md: FR-CCEF-003 specifies a 20-minute cooldown for code resend but does not define the user-facing error message content or whether a countdown timer should be shown. The prototype includes a resend button but no cooldown indicator. UX copy and interaction detail for rate-limited states should be specified.
- product/requirements/NFR-CCEF-003.md: NFR-CCEF-003 requires HTTP 429 with Retry-After header but does not specify the user-facing error message content. UX copy for rate-limited authentication attempts (e.g., 'Too many attempts, please try again in X minutes') should be defined for consistency.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-004.md: Account settings (UC-CCEF-004) has no prototype screen or visual design reference. The use case describes profile editing, avatar management, and notification preferences but provides no interaction detail. The prototype's sidebar account menu shows a path to settings but the settings page itself is not designed.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-006.md: Account linking/unlinking (UC-CCEF-006) has no prototype screen or visual design reference. The use case describes connecting and disconnecting cloud provider accounts but provides no interaction detail (confirmation dialogs, success/error states). The prototype's 'Add a cloud account' modal is for provider connection but not specifically tied to this use case.
- product/requirements/FR-CCEF-018.md: FR-CCEF-018 defines input validation constraints but does not specify the format or content of inline error messages. UX copy for validation errors (e.g., 'Email must be a valid format', 'Password must be at least 8 characters') should be defined for consistency across all forms.
- product/requirements/NFR-CCEF-002.md: NFR-CCEF-002 defines response time benchmarks (800ms SSO, 500ms OTP) but does not specify the loading state design (spinner, skeleton, disabled button). The prototype shows a comparison engine loading screen but no auth-specific loading states. UX loading state design should be specified for the auth flow.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-001.md: UC-CCEF-001 does not define error journey detail for SSO provider failures (e.g., Google/Apple service unavailable, consent denied by user). The use case focuses on happy path and basic failure but does not specify error messages, retry behavior, or fallback options for provider-side failures.
- product/requirements/FR-CCEF-001.md: FR-CCEF-001 defines Google SSO technical requirements but does not specify user-facing error messages for common failure modes (consent denied, account already linked, email mismatch). UX copy and error journey detail should be added.
- product/requirements/FR-CCEF-002.md: FR-CCEF-002 defines Apple SSO technical requirements but does not specify user-facing error messages for common failure modes (consent denied, account already linked). UX copy and error journey detail should be added.

## Required Changes

## Suggested Changes

- product/docs/ux/prototype-registry.md: Consider adding an accessibility compliance checklist to the prototype registry usage rules. Require that any new prototype revision includes or references a WCAG 2.1 AA compliance assessment before being used as implementation input.
- product/requirements/NFR-CCEF-002.md: Consider adding a UX loading state specification: define whether auth flows show spinners, skeleton screens, or disabled buttons during token exchange and validation. This would help frontend implementation align with performance expectations.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-005.md: The prototype includes a TC gate screen with checkbox and 'Agree and continue' button. Consider adding explicit success criteria for the legal acceptance flow: what happens if user declines, whether partial acceptance is allowed, and how the system records consent timestamp.
- product/requirements/FR-CCEF-006.md: Consider adding UX specification for consent granularity: whether users can accept/reject individual processing purposes, whether defaults are pre-checked (GDPR requires explicit consent), and how withdrawal of consent is surfaced in the UI.
- product/slices/PS-CCEF-001/slice.md: Consider adding a UX-specific success criterion: 'Users can complete authentication and onboarding without encountering unhandled error states or confusing navigation.' This would provide a measurable UX quality gate for milestone planning.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-003.md: Add interaction detail for language selection: specify UI component type (dropdown, radio group), auto-detection behavior, fallback language, and whether changes apply immediately or require re-login. Link to a prototype screen or wireframe.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-007.md: Add interaction detail for data subject rights: specify UI components for each right (access request form, rectification editor, erasure confirmation dialog, export format selector), status indicators for pending requests, and success/error states.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-008.md: Add interaction detail for data residency: specify UI component for region selection, confirmation flow, and whether users can change their preference after account creation. Link to a prototype screen or wireframe.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-004.md: Add interaction detail for account settings: specify UI layout for profile editing, avatar upload flow (drag-and-drop vs file picker), notification preference toggles, and save/cancel behavior. Link to a prototype screen or wireframe.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-006.md: Add interaction detail for account linking/unlinking: specify UI for provider selection, OAuth redirect flow indication, confirmation dialog before unlinking, and success/error states. Link to a prototype screen or wireframe.
- product/requirements/FR-CCEF-003.md: Specify user-facing error message content for OTP resend cooldown (e.g., 'Please wait X minutes before requesting a new code'), include countdown timer behavior, and define the disabled state for the resend button.
- product/requirements/NFR-CCEF-003.md: Specify user-facing error message content for rate-limited authentication attempts (e.g., 'Too many login attempts. Please try again in X minutes'), include Retry-After information, and define the visual state for rate-limited forms.
- product/requirements/FR-CCEF-018.md: Specify inline error message content and placement for all input validations (email format, password strength, phone number format). Define whether errors appear below the field, as a summary at the top of the form, or both.
- product/use-cases/UC-CCEF-001.md: Add error journey detail for SSO provider failures: specify user-facing messages for consent denied, account already linked, email mismatch between providers, and provider service unavailable. Define retry behavior and fallback options.
- product/requirements/FR-CCEF-001.md: Add user-facing error message specifications for Google SSO failure modes: consent denied, account already linked to different email, provider timeout. Define whether errors are shown inline or in a modal.
- product/requirements/FR-CCEF-002.md: Add user-facing error message specifications for Apple SSO failure modes: consent denied, account already linked to different email, provider timeout. Define whether errors are shown inline or in a modal.
